camel_example: aliyun cdn DescribeDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2020-07-06T22:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn hangzhou --StartTime '2020-07-05T22:00:00Z' --Layer all --Interval 300
description_en: Queries HTTP status codes by protocol
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer按协议分类获取HTTP状态码数据
kebab_example: aliyun cdn describe-domain-http-code-data-by-layer --domain-name example.com --start-time 2020-07-05T22:00:00Z --end-time 2020-07-06T22:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en hangzhou --layer all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

If you do not specify this parameter, data of all accelerated domain names under your account is queried
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询。

若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data entries. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). For more information, see Usage notes
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISP names.

If you do not specify an ISP, data of all ISPs is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得。

不传值代表所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions.

If you do not specify a region, data in all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名，通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获得。

不传值代表所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The protocol by which you want to query HTTP status codes. The network layer supports IPv4 and IPv6. The application layer supports http, https, and quic. You can also set the value to all.

Default value: all
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度，可选应用层（http、https、quic）或 all。

默认为all
parameters.name: layer

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the data entries returned. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒
